Options:
- Option A: Short 30-minute intro this week — Friday 11/21 at 3:00 PM PT (we can cover the high-level architecture and next steps).
- Option B: Full 45-minute demo the week of Dec 1 — Tue 12/2 at 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET or Wed 12/3 at 2:00 PM PT / 5:00 PM ET.

If you prefer Option B, I'll send a calendar invite (ICS) for your chosen slot. If Option A, we can do a quick pre-demo with me + Marissa (solutions engineer) to cover technical constraints.

Also attaching a calendar stub for the re:Invent blackout window so you and your team have a single doc (reInvent-blackout-calendar.ics) for reference.
